note: Small treed campground on one loop near the Hwy 734 bridge over the Brazeau River, 72 km north of Nordegg on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 734), run by the Fox Creek Development Association for West Fraser; seniors C$15. A large picnic shelter with a wood stove and free firewood. The hand-pump water is not safe to drink; bring water. Not maintained in the off season. --Claude
